conditions.condition_text: Mark out the high and the low of the first 15-minute candle (9:30-9:45 AM ET) on the 15m chart.
These levels define the initial trading range for the strategy.
Wait for a Fair Value Gap (FVG) to print on the 5-minute chart that breaks through the 15-minute range.
The FVG acts as the mechanical displacement signal to confirm the direction.
Place a limit order at the FVG level on the 5m chart.
Entering on the FVG allows for a high-probability entry as the market rebalances into the gap.
The strategy requires starting the trading day at 9:30 AM ET.
The initial 15-minute candle must close to define the high and low range.
A Fair Value Gap must print on the 5m chart that breaks the 15m range.
The stop is placed at the low of the first candle of the Fair Value Gap.
The target is set at a fixed two to one risk to reward ratio.
